experiment: Uni O, released GBRL code settings
university: All 2000 original test rows in dataset order, one summary each. Full test measurement is an evaluation-only addition to authors training loop.
C_R: Correct binary university class (PASS good, FAIL bad) / 2000; not individual institution-name prediction.
C_I: Operational static observer flag fraction / 2000; not ground-truth transmission detection accuracy. Labeled observer control accuracy reported separately.
d: Qwen3-4B judge rejection OR 2-4 sentence format failure / same 100 PIQA training questions. Establishes d_0; later compare d_t and d_t-d_0.

university_generation.backend: transformers4.43.2 HF model.generate, equivalent sampler parameters to source TRL.generate
university_generation.sampling_seed: evaluation_seed+10000+microbatch_start; independent seeds permit atomic resumption
university_generation.source_evaluation_difference: Full ordered2000 instead of shuffled rounded192; explicit evaluation seeds isolated from author training RNG. Not bit-for-bit replay of author training run.

initialization.order: sender LoRA/valuehead, reference copy, DistilBERT random heads then replacement classifier
initialization.sender_dtype: float16 as actual released cuda:0 conditional branch
initialization.checkpoint_rng_stage: before PPO constructor; future author PPO setup resets seed0 then loads observer/calibrates

observer.scoring_position: last column, preserving source pad-position behavior

piqa_sender.prompt_adaptation: single user turn because Gemma has no separate system role

piqa_judge: Existing FrozenInferenceEngine with unchanged Qwen judge messages, 256 thinking tokens, final constrained YES/NO verdict; no private reasoning saved.
